findings.claim: IsPublicReadWrite has its field check inverted: `field.IsReadOnly && !field.IsConst` should be `!field.IsReadOnly && !field.IsConst`. In contractless mode a plain public mutable field (`public int MutableField;`) is silently left out of serialization, which breaks the requirement that public members are serialized. A `public readonly` field is included and marked writable, so the generated Deserialize assigns to a readonly field and the formatter fails to compile (CS0191). Surrogate mode uses the same predicate, so a surrogate keyed on a mutable field gets MsgPack022, while one keyed on a readonly field produces uncompilable code.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.GeneratedFormatterReceiptsTests.Contractless_PublicMutableField_IsSerialized and Contractless_ReadOnlyField_DoesNotBreakGeneratedFormatter. ProjectA.Data has `public int MutableField; public readonly int ReadOnlyField;` in a referenced assembly. On head the first test fails because the generated formatter never mentions MutableField. The second fails because the generated tree has CS0191 errors.

findings.claim: The requirement says that if T carries MessagePack attributes they are honoured. When no surrogate is given, Collect always calls CreateContractlessMembers and never reads [MessagePackObject], [Key] or [IgnoreMember] on T. A referenced type with `[MessagePackObject] class Data { [Key(0)] int Value; [IgnoreMember] int Hidden; }` therefore gets a string-keyed formatter that serializes Hidden and ignores the declared int keys. This is wire-incompatible with the dynamic resolver and with the defining assembly's own contract.
